chunks: When you wish to shave your head, then face the Qiblah, begin with the forelock, and shave your head up to the two protruding bones from the temples opposite the base of the two ears.
Then when you have shaved, say: “O Allah, grant me light for every hair on the Day of Resurrection,” and bury your hair in Mina.

key_terms.الصُّدْغَيْنِ: the two temples on the sides of the head
key_terms.الْعَظْمَيْنِ: the two bones marking the extent mentioned for shaving
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةَ: the direction to be faced during the act
key_terms.بِالنَّاصِيَةِ: the forelock or front part of the head from which shaving begins
key_terms.بِمِنًى: Mina, where the shaved hair is to be buried
key_terms.نُورًا: light, requested as a reward on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection, when the reward is sought

ai.seo_question: How should halq be performed in hajj, and what supplication should be said after shaving the head?
ai.summary: This text outlines the manner of halq in the rituals of hajj: facing the Qiblah, beginning from the nasyah, and shaving in the specified direction. It also teaches a du'a to recite after shaving and instructs that the hair be buried in Mina, linking the rite to devotion and remembrance of the Day of Resurrection.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
SHAVING (HALQ)
When you wish to shave your head:
1.	Face the Qibla.
2.	Begin shaving from the forehead (nasiyah).
3.	Continue shaving towards the two bones at the temples, located opposite the ear supports.

4.	Once you have finished shaving, recite:
o	"O Allah (swt), grant me light for every hair on the Day of Resurrection."
5.	Collect your hair and bury it in Mina as part of the prescribed ritual.
